frames.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent PNG animation frame for the oneBeat existing comic character cast.
Primary request: EDIT Image 1 only. Retouch its linework to match the established characters in Images 2–4, remove the entire gray background and lower-right white rounded text box, reconstruct any boot portions obscured by the box, and replace the blurred floor shadow with hand-drawn ink contact-shadow strokes.
Input roles: Image 1 is the sole pose, framing, identity and color authority. Images 2–4 are ink/linework and cel-shading style references only; do not borrow their characters, clothes, poses or props.
Style: bold, slightly irregular variable-weight black outer contours, thinner confident interior lines, restrained short directional hatching in folds, hair and footwear; flat comic cel colors with restrained shadow planes. Same approachable hand-drawn comic finish as the reference cast, not smooth generic vector art, not 3D, not painterly. Keep hatching sparse, avoid making black areas muddy.
Preserve: this exact character's slate-blue skin, thick black twin braids with ivory bands and ivory fringe streak, cool half-lidded eye and natural right-facing profile, gaze forward toward screen-right (never at the viewer), mouthless face, ivory loose jersey with brick-red sleeves and dark collar, black loose shorts, asymmetric ivory/black socks and violet chunky lace-up boots with ivory soles and toe caps. Keep the target's actual sock placement. Preserve original joint angles, hand shapes, braid motion, leg overlap and shoe orientation. No redesign or new facial expression.
Composition: one whole character, eye-level camera, same normalized head/body/foot positions, scale, margins and ground baseline as Image 1. Square canvas, preferably 1254 × 1254. Do not crop hair or shoes. No sheet or multiple views.
Shadows: at the original ground baseline draw low, tapered, horizontally running charcoal/black ink strokes with a few closely spaced fine hatch lines. Dense and short directly under the planted sole; lighter, thinner sparse projected strokes beneath an airborne foot at ground level. Shadow must visibly be LINE DRAWN with transparent gaps, not a soft blurred gray ellipse, solid black oval, glow, floating shadow glued to an elevated sole, or long floor stripe.
Background: genuine RGBA transparency everywhere outside character and ink shadow, including gaps between braids and limbs. No gray, white, black or checkerboard background, no halo or ground plane.
Remove all lower-right lettering and its rounded rectangle, restore obscured purple boot and ivory outsole using surrounding contours. No text, watermark, badge or border.
Change only line rendering, background/text removal and contact-shadow rendering; keep every other detail faithful to Image 1.
Pose-specific constraints: Frame 01: wide rightward stride. Screen-left trailing black-sock boot raised/tilted; screen-right ivory-sock boot planted. Preserve the open stride and exact arm swing.
